description: Use this when the user wants Winquill to do something on its own, again and again: add strong fits to the pipeline, remind people of sprint steps, check a bid before it closes, say what a buyer changed, or send a morning shortlist or a report. Makes one from the library, saved off. Read its rules back to the user; it runs only once turned on with turn_on_automation. Automations never submit a bid, write to a buyer or email anyone outside the team. Needs a Winquill account. Example: {"template":"morning_shortlist"}

asked.description: What the user asked for, in their words.

changes.description: What the user asked to change from the library's version.

at.description: For a shortlist or report: the time, e.g. "08:00", between 07:30 and 18:30.

call_to.description: Who gets the bid call: a name or email of someone in the workspace, or "me".

channel.description: A connected Slack or Teams channel to post to, e.g. "#bids".

hours.description: For the pre-submission check: hours before the deadline.

min_days_left.description: Only tenders with at least this many days before the deadline.

min_value.description: Only tenders worth at least this, in the tender's currency.

most.description: For the shortlist: how many tenders.

regions.description: Only tenders in these regions, e.g. ["Scotland"].

tell_person.description: Someone to tell instead: a name or email, or "me".

words.description: Only tenders that mention one of these words.

working_days.description: For sprint reminders: working days before a step is due.

template.description: The library automation to make: morning_shortlist (Morning shortlist: Each weekday, the best new fits, each with a line on why it fits.); strong_fit (Strong fit to pipeline: Adds strong fits to the pipeline, checks readiness and gives out the bid call.); change_guard (Change guard: Says what a buyer changed and moves the sprint's dates to a new deadline.); renewals (Certificates and renewals: 60, 30 and 7 days before a certificate, policy or registration runs out.); sprint_autopilot (Sprint on autopilot: Reminds whoever has a step two working days before it's due, and says when one is late.); pre_submission (Pre-submission check: 72 hours out: word limits, gaps and open steps. 24 hours out: is it in?); award_debrief (Award and debrief: Says who won when the award is published, and drafts a request for feedback.); weekly_report (Weekly pipeline report: Mondays: pipeline value, bids due, results and anything overdue.).

workspace.description: The Winquill workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: add_automation

wouldHave.description: What it would have done over the last 30 days.

title: Add an automation
